name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: A container for grouping a set of buttons and controls.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Toolbar } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Toolbar.ButtonProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Toolbar.Button class={cn(className)} data-slot="toolbar-button" {...restProps}>
  {@render children?.()}
</Toolbar.Button>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Toolbar } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Toolbar.GroupItemProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Toolbar.GroupItem class={cn(className)} data-slot="toolbar-group-item" {...restProps}>
  {@render children?.()}
</Toolbar.GroupItem>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Toolbar } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Toolbar.GroupProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, type = 'single', ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Toolbar.Group
  class={cn('flex items-center gap-1', className)}
  data-slot="toolbar-group"
  {type}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</Toolbar.Group>

<script lang="ts">
  import type { HTMLInputAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = HTMLInputAttributes;

  let { class: className, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<input class={cn(className)} data-slot="toolbar-input" {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Toolbar } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Toolbar.LinkProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Toolbar.Link class={cn(className)} data-slot="toolbar-link" {...restProps}>
  {@render children?.()}
</Toolbar.Link>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Separator } from 'bits-ui';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Separator.RootProps;

  let { class: className, orientation = 'vertical', ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Separator.Root
  class={cn(
    "shrink-0 bg-border data-[orientation=horizontal]:my-0.5 data-[orientation=vertical]:my-1.5 data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-px data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-full data-[orientation=vertical]:w-px data-[orientation=vertical]:not-[[class^='h-']]:not-[[class*='_h-']]:self-stretch",
    className
  )}
  data-slot="toolbar-separator"
  {orientation}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Toolbar } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Toolbar.RootProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Toolbar.Root
  class={cn(
    'relative flex gap-2 rounded-xl border bg-card not-dark:bg-clip-padding p-1 text-card-foreground',
    className
  )}
  data-slot="toolbar"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</Toolbar.Root>
